title: 7 PitchMonster Alternatives for AI Sales Roleplay in 2026
summary: Compare 7 PitchMonster alternatives for AI sales roleplay, with best-fit labels, public pricing checked October 2026 and a two-week pilot scorecard.
body_markdown:
Tool


Best for


Main difference from PitchMonster


Public pricing (checked October 2026)


PitchMonster


Several practice modes from one vendor


Baseline: phone, avatar and screen-share roleplay; call analysis on the higher plan


No price; two quote-based plans per seat ([pricing](https://www.pitchmonster.io/pricing) )


Quotain


Practice built from a specific account and call


Buyer starts from your accounts, calls and playbook; retry one moment


Free trial up to 3 calls; Team plan quoted ([pricing](https://www.quotain.com/pricing) )


Hyperbound


Buying committees and demo practice with real-call scoring


Separate Practice and Perform licenses


Free plan; paid plans quoted per user ([pricing](https://www.hyperbound.ai/pricing) )


Outdoo


The widest set of practice modes


Voice, chat, video and in-person modes; not priced per seat


Free plan with 60 minutes of credits; paid plans quoted ([pricing](https://www.outdoo.ai/pricing) )


Second Nature


Video avatar onboarding and courses


Moving avatars plus courses with videos, decks and quizzes


No price on the pages reviewed ([product](https://secondnature.ai/product/) )


Kendo


Small teams that want a published price


Per-seat prices with roleplay minutes included


Pro $55 and Max $100 per seat per month ([pricing](https://kendo.ai/pricing) )


Yoodli


Individual reps and communication skills


Self-serve individual plans plus team plans


Free, $8 and $20 a month billed annually; teams quoted ([pricing](https://yoodli.ai/pricing) )


Mindtickle


Roleplay inside an enterprise enablement suite


AI role play sits beside training, content and readiness tools


Depends on company size and team structure ([role play](https://www.mindtickle.com/platform/ai-sales-role-play/) )
